premises.text: Finding a specific visual product is hard with text search across stores and Google, yielding unrelated results
premises.evidence_span: it was very difficult to put in words a visual product that I had in mind. And I got a lot of unrelated results

premises.text: Donde guides users through short attribute questions (color, sleeves, pattern, etc.) to find the right product in under 15 seconds
premises.evidence_span: With Donde, you can find exactly what you're looking for in less than 15 seconds

premises.text: A learning mechanism personalizes results using contextual user information such as location, age, taste, and environment
premises.evidence_span: learning mechanism that combines the contextual information of the search of the user. her location, her age, everything that we can know about her taste and her environment

premises.text: Backend scrapes stores, extracts item fingerprints, builds a cross-retailer ontology, and uses AI to choose the next best question
premises.evidence_span: Scraping the data of different websites and different stores extracting the unique fingerprints of every item and using and creating an ontology

premises.text: Users can buy the found item on the spot in the app
premises.evidence_span: When I found a dress, I can buy it on the spot
